data.title: Justin Sun sells 80%-90% of Ethereum, shifts fo... | Pluang
data.description: Justin Sun, CEO of TRON, sold 80%-90% of his Ethereum holdings, citing a bearish double top pattern and sluggish performance in ETH. He plans to reallocate these funds into US crypto stocks, which he believes are undervalued and offer better growth potential. Sun's move aims to diversify his portfolio and capitalize on the US market's opportunities, including his investment in World Liberty Financial, a US-based DeFi platform. This shift highlights a strategic pivot from Ethereum to US crypto equities amid market challenges.
data.author: Zycrypto
